name: Ivory Meher Top-Handle Bag
description: An elegant ivory top-handle bag with a sculpted silhouette, smooth leather-look finish and understated gold-tone clasp. A detachable shoulder strap takes it from daytime gatherings to evening plans.

name: Burgundy Ayla Crescent Bag
description: A softly curved crescent bag in rich burgundy with a slender adjustable strap and a discreet zip closure. The smooth leather-look texture and warm gold-tone buckle bring a polished touch to everyday dressing.

name: Mocha Mira Woven Tote
description: Rich mocha tones and an intricate woven texture come together in a softly structured tote. Rounded shoulder handles and a roomy silhouette make this an easy companion for workdays, shopping and weekend plans.

name: Noir Sana Quilted Shoulder Bag
description: A compact black shoulder bag with soft grid quilting, a refined gold-tone turn lock and a chain strap with a matching shoulder section. An understated finishing touch for dinners, celebrations and evenings out.

name: Caramel Rumi Bucket Bag
description: A warm caramel bucket bag with a soft drawstring closure, curved top handle and detachable shoulder strap. Its clean shape, fine-grain leather-look finish and delicate gold-tone details pair beautifully with relaxed outfits.

name: Blush Lila Mini Bow Bag
description: A petite blush-pink handbag with rounded corners, sculpted handles and a delicate tonal bow. Carry it by hand or add the slender shoulder strap for a soft, feminine accent to daytime and occasion looks.
